name: Your Move
summary: A phone-sized GitHub inbox: what moved across your repositories, and whose move it is.
decisions: Reads GitHub live over GraphQL: no database, no mirror, no webhooks.
Whose move it is is derived on every load; only results are cached, and the board shows their age rather than hiding it.
The session is the user's own GitHub token, sealed with AES-GCM in an HttpOnly cookie, so there is no server-side store to run or back up.
Designed from the phone up, the hardest width, then out to every other.
